name: NativeSelect
description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class NativeSelect < Base
    WRAPPER_CLASS = "group/native-select relative w-fit has-[select:disabled]:opacity-50"

    # As in shadcn, class styles the wrapper <div>; every other attribute
    # goes to the <select>.
    def initialize(size: :default, **attrs)
      @size = size
      @wrapper_classes = [attrs.delete(:class), attrs.delete("class")].compact
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(
        class: TAILWIND_MERGER.merge(mix({class: WRAPPER_CLASS}, *@wrapper_classes.map { |c| {class: c} })[:class]),
        data: {slot: "native-select-wrapper", size: @size}
      ) do
        select(**attrs, &block)
        render RubyUI::NativeSelectIcon.new
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "native-select",
          size: @size,
          ruby_ui__form_field_target: "input",
          action: "change->ruby-ui--form-field#onChange invalid->ruby-ui--form-field#onInvalid"
        },
        class: [
          "h-9 w-full min-w-0 appearance-none rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent py-1 pr-8 pl-2.5 text-sm shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none select-none data-[size=sm]:h-8 dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
          "placeholder:text-muted-foreground",
          "selection:bg-primary selection:text-primary-foreground",
          "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
          "disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
          "aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class NativeSelectGroup < Base
    def view_template(&)
      optgroup(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "native-select-optgroup"},
        class: "bg-[Canvas] text-[CanvasText]"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class NativeSelectIcon < Base
    # Renders the chevron <svg> itself, as shadcn does. A block replaces the
    # chevron; its content is wrapped in a <span> that takes the same classes.
    def view_template(&block)
      if block
        span(**attrs, &block)
      else
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          **attrs
        ) do |s|
          s.path(d: "m6 9 6 6 6-6")
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "native-select-icon"},
        class: "text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 right-2.5 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 select-none"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class NativeSelectOption < Base
    def view_template(&)
      option(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    # System colors keep options readable in the browser's native picker,
    # whatever the page's color scheme.
    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "native-select-option"},
        class: "bg-[Canvas] text-[CanvasText]"
      }
    end
  end
end
